stages.success_gate_evidence: Local foundation independently revalidated: Python 3.14, two isolated databases, seven denials, GPU correctness and HTTP200.
stages.limitations: Full clean-machine service reproduction remains a separate unproved gate.

stages.success_gate_evidence: Two genuine fixture captures: 380 source records each; raw/provenance/Medusa/SQL/Maria/CHILD Joomla path.
stages.limitations: CLI/API producer validated; inherited Desktop rendered-page producer remains blocked.

stages.success_gate_evidence: Two real bounded adapters, explicit identities, immutable prospective clock, daily task and source failures.
stages.limitations: One fixture provider; no lawful real odds; short commissioning window does not prove sustained reliability.

stages.success_gate_evidence: 22 scoped feature outputs; point-in-time lineage and all321 forecasts exactly reproducible.
stages.limitations: Lineup, injury and market features remain explicitly missing; feature value is not universal.

stages.success_gate_evidence: Seven distinct methods share typed inputs/output; chronological comparison and CPU/GPU measurements.
stages.limitations: Experimental mathematical implementation; no predictive superiority or new runtime justified.

stages.success_gate_evidence: Poisson/DC finite matrices, seeded Monte Carlo and explicit scenario mixtures are implemented/tested.
stages.limitations: Strict historical observation history and empirically validated scenario effects unavailable.

stages.success_gate_evidence: Equal/prior-loss ensembles, transparent disagreement, score/calibration and evidence diagnostics.
stages.limitations: Current predictions use equal weighting; no external stacking validation or superiority claim.

stages.success_gate_evidence: Typed markets/providers, temporal trajectories, overround, proportional/power normalization and fair-odds tests.
stages.limitations: Real market gate BLOCKED: terms prohibit one source; alternative needs authorized API credentials.

stages.success_gate_evidence: Bounded need ranking, policy gate, acquisition/validation/recalculation and measured controlled entropy change.
stages.limitations: Controlled synthetic intervention only; real-world uncertainty-reduction benefit not demonstrated.

stages.success_gate_evidence: Walk-forward proper scores, calibration, ablations, replay, scheduled outcome-scoring and immutable forecast ledger.
stages.limitations: No prospective actual outcome yet; one season and no market/source incremental-value benchmark.

stages.success_gate_evidence: Thirteen typed logical heads share acquisition and expose explicit availability/maturity on dashboard.
stages.limitations: Only match/team/historical/weather operational; other heads lack approved relevant data/identity proof.

status_meaning: COMPLETE refers to the declared scoped experimental gate, never production maturity; every version attempted.
checkpoint_note: Original donor and all earlier CHILD checkpoints preserved. These stage closure checkpoints were created after integrated validation, not claimed as earlier stage-by-stage timestamps.
